from solution import sort_sublists


def test_issue_example_from_issue():
    """Sort each sublist of strings as in the issue example."""
    # 3 sublists with lens 2,2,3 -> 3 sorted sublists; 'black' < 'orange' < 'white'
    assert sort_sublists((["green", "orange"], ["black", "white"], ["white", "black", "orange"])) == [['green', 'orange'], ['black', 'white'], ['black', 'orange', 'white']]


def test_issue_empty_outer_list():
    """Sort each sublist of an empty outer list returns empty list."""
    # 0 sublists -> 0 sublists, 0 == 0
    assert sort_sublists([]) == []


def test_issue_single_sublist_unsorted():
    """Sort each sublist sorts a single unsorted sublist."""
    # 3 items: 'c' > 'b' > 'a', sorted is 'a' < 'b' < 'c'
    assert sort_sublists([["c", "a", "b"]]) == [["a", "b", "c"]]


def test_issue_outer_order_preserved():
    """Sort each sublist without reordering the outer list."""
    # outer len 2 -> 2; inners: 'b' > 'a' and 'd' > 'c', so sorted inners
    assert sort_sublists([["b", "a"], ["d", "c"]]) == [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]]


def test_issue_empty_sublists_stay_empty():
    """Sort each sublist leaves empty sublists empty."""
    # 2 sublists with 0 + 1 items = 1 item total; [] stays []
    assert sort_sublists([[], ["b", "a"]]) == [[], ["a", "b"]]


def test_issue_singleton_sublists_unchanged():
    """Sort each sublist leaves single-element sublists unchanged."""
    # 2 sublists with 1 + 1 = 2 items; singletons already sorted
    assert sort_sublists([["z"], ["a"]]) == [["z"], ["a"]]


def test_issue_duplicate_strings_sorted():
    """Sort each sublist keeps duplicates in sorted order."""
    # 4 items: 2 x 'a' + 2 x 'b' = 4, ordered 'a' <= 'a' <= 'b' <= 'b'
    assert sort_sublists([["b", "a", "b", "a"]]) == [["a", "a", "b", "b"]]


def test_issue_reverse_sorted_sublist():
    """Sort each sublist sorts a reverse-sorted sublist ascending."""
    # 3 items: 'c' > 'b' > 'a', ascending is 'a' < 'b' < 'c'
    assert sort_sublists([["c", "b", "a"]]) == [["a", "b", "c"]]


def test_contract_returns_list_of_lists():
    """Returned value is a list of lists."""
    # 1 sublist with 2 items -> 1 list containing 1 list, 1 == 1
    result = sort_sublists([["b", "a"]])
    assert result == [["a", "b"]]
    assert isinstance(result, list) and isinstance(result[0], list)


def test_contract_accepts_tuple_of_lists():
    """Input may be a tuple of lists as in the example."""
    # outer len 2 -> 2; 'b' > 'a', 'd' > 'c', so 2 sorted pairs
    assert sort_sublists((["b", "a"], ["d", "c"])) == [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]]
